scripts.build:ui: rm -rf ui/dist && bun build ui/index.html --outdir ui/dist --minify --define 'process.env.NODE_ENV="production"'
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run build:ui && bun test && bun run check:shell
scripts.check:shell: for f in install.sh uninstall.sh app/build.sh scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done && shellcheck install.sh uninstall.sh app/build.sh scripts/*.sh
scripts.check:app: cd app && swift build -c release && swift test
scripts.docs:dev: bun run docs:install && bun run --cwd site dev
scripts.docs:build: bun run docs:install && bun run --cwd site build
